_what: HAND-VERIFIED arrival ground truth for CAM.112, 2026-07-28 19:30:00 -> 19:50:00.
_how: Every IN event the slit counter reported was checked by extracting the doorway crop (SOURCE x2300-3840, y1250-2160) at t-2,-1,0,+1,+2 seconds and looking at it. A verdict of 'empty' means no body is present in ANY of the five frames, so it cannot be a timing artefact.
_why_this_exists: Before this file, every accuracy claim in the project was self-graded: HOTA was never measured and the three arrival estimators disagreed 6 / 6 / 21 with no way to adjudicate. This is the first externally-checkable number the project has.
_limits: ONE 20-minute window on ONE camera. Not a HOTA ground truth, not a tracking ground truth -- arrivals only.
Verified by reading frames, not by being present at the venue. A person fully occluded by the door frame for all 5 samples would be missed.
Only the slit's candidate times were checked. A crossing that NO estimator proposed would not appear here, so the true count is a LOWER bound.
